verdict.rationale: Paperspace documents selectable machine types grouped into CPU, GPU and multi-GPU, with NVIDIA H100 among the high-end options. Its catalog also includes previous-generation GPUs: A100s with up to 8 GPUs are advertised, and a user reports running on a Quadro P6000. The core of the story is therefore delivered, though H100 access requires an approval request. missing for 10: evidence of H200/B200-class availability, documented per-GPU pricing showing the older options are cheaper, ungated access to H100 without approval, independent corroboration of H100 availability.
